purpose: Mandatory official-core discovery and identity-collision baseline for every Snippet repository; add authorized task-specific repositories without removing the core.
identity_policy: A new snippet or snippet type requires a securely generated UUIDv4 checked against current core and configured indexes plus local additions. Preserve identity when improving the same item or maintaining an explicitly intended fork override. A new unrelated snippet must never reuse a core GUID.
ordering: Discovery order does not override the consuming JCB installation's configured repository precedence. Preserve all matches and provenance.
